q: Why is Gripen E/F below budget?

r.response: Gripen E/F is SEK 617M below budget in the Q3 forecast (SEK 12.36B vs SEK 12.98B, −4.8%), and the shortfall is spread across every quarter: −136M in Q1, −149M in Q2, −133M in Q3 and −200M in Q4. Because revenue is recognised as hours are burned, fewer hours mean less revenue and less cost at the same time, so programme EBIT only moves from SEK 688M to SEK 654M. This is a timing problem, not a margin problem: the hours and the milestones move into 2027.

q: What happens to EBIT if supply-chain delays slip deliveries into 2027?
